Finding / Evidence: Part III Q3: 'Early Booking' bookings were not completed 53.4% of the time (47/88) versus 27.3% for 'Last Minute' (24/88).
Functional Requirement: The system shall send the requester an automated reconfirmation request for every reservation in the 'Early Booking' lead-time category (more than 14 days ahead), and shall release or flag the slot if it is not reconfirmed by the administrator-defined deadline.

Finding / Evidence: Part III Q2: Individual Student had the highest cancellation/no-show rate (47.1%, 48/102) versus 37.3% overall.
Functional Requirement: The system shall calculate and display on the administrator dashboard the cancellation and no-show rate for each user category, with the number of reservations behind each rate, and shall highlight categories above the overall rate (currently Individual Student).

Finding / Evidence: Part IV: decision tree (test accuracy 0.65, recall 0.52, precision 0.53); most influential predictors: Lead_Time_Days, Participants, User_Category.
Functional Requirement: The system shall compute a predicted risk level (Low / Medium / High) for each new reservation request at submission time using only fields known at submission, shall display it to the administrator labelled as a prediction together with the top contributing factors (Lead_Time_Days, Participants, User_Category), and shall never reject or cancel a reservation automatically on the basis of the prediction.
